name: Stone Golem Elementalist
summary: Golem Elementalist with a small Stone Golem pack. The golems are permanent, aggressive and easy to keep alive; the same caster gear as the Witch minion builds carries them. No required unique, low APM and a good Dad build.

summary.text: Stone Golem Elementalist is a low-APM minion build that measures 22.7k at red maps and 40.2k at pinnacle. The golems are permanent and no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with skeletons until the golem gem unlocks, then bring the Stone Golems with you. The first checkpoint measures 344 life and 50 damage; the second measures 126.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 22.7k damage, 36242 effective life and 13563 physical max hit. Keep the golems between you and the pack, cap the resistances, and let the filter hide the rest.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 40.2k damage with 42698 effective life and 13302 physical max hit. Refresh the golems before the burst and keep Flesh Offering up.
